verdict.rationale: Otter documents a natural-language interface, Otter AI Chat, that answers questions across meetings and connected apps and drafts follow-ups and reports. It can also query CRMs, and its MCP server lets Claude or ChatGPT search and recap meetings conversationally. The evidence covers natural-language querying and content generation, not operating the product itself (recording, scheduling, sharing, settings) through commands. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control of product actions and configuration, and independent hands-on corroboration of AI Chat's command capabilities.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Otter AI Chat searches across your meetings and connected apps to instantly answer questions and help you create follow-ups, reports, and content.
Find key insights from past calls, documents, and more using natural-language.
allow you to query your CRM directly through Otter AI Chat for more personalized responses
Search, recap, and draft follow-ups without leaving the chat.
